title: Power Audit Report
description: DESIGN-stage advisory artifact. Output of statistics-power-auditor. Assesses whether the experiment has sufficient statistical power (seeds, sample size) relative to profile-declared minimums. Advisory verdict: sufficient true/false, derived from n_seeds vs profile min_seeds. Director-ADR override per decision D.

sufficient.description: Advisory verdict: true = declared n_seeds >= profile minimum; false = insufficient power

n_seeds_declared.description: Number of seeds declared in the experiment config

min_seeds_required.description: Minimum seeds from profile hard_invariants or min_seeds field. null = profile does not declare a minimum (advisory-only, no threshold to check).

power_concerns.description: Human-readable advisory concerns about statistical power (e.g. n=1 is insufficient for variance estimation)

adr_override_ref.description: ADR id if director explicitly approved running with insufficient power (decision D override)
